subject: /workspaces/bmad-multi-user/skills/team-status
verdict: Critical soft_offer reason-string bug mis-targets depends_on-undefined; otherwise lean simple-workflow board with medium ceremony in Ready.
summary: team-status correctly pushes ready/explain plumbing into status.py and wires customize.toml like its siblings. The ship blocker is soft_offer_for_check classifying English gate reasons—depends_on 'X' has no gate definition routes soft_offer_story to the checked story instead of X. Secondary: Ready restates script filters, read-only vs mkdir tension, and under-surfaced soft_offers on all-blocked.

themes.title: Soft-offer intelligence leak
themes.root_cause: status.py maps handoffs by English substrings from gates.py reasons; order shadows depends_on-undefined onto the wrong story.
themes.action: Emit stable reason codes from team-gates (or shared mapper) and map codes→soft_offer; add a unit test for depends_on undefined.

themes.title: Ready ceremony vs script truth
themes.root_cause: SKILL.md re-teaches filters and presentation the script already owns, while under-using script soft_offers on all-blocked.
themes.action: Trust script cohorts/soft_offers; trim Ready bullets and interactive script; always surface soft_offer when present.

themes.title: Principle / entry polish
themes.root_cause: Read-only bar conflicts with mkdir; unfinished invite fires before sprint exists; builder memlog sits at skill root.
themes.action: Narrow read-only to no gate/sprint mutations; invite unfinished only when sprint exists; leave/gitignore builder .memlog.md like siblings.

strengths: Deterministic ready/explain via status.py + sibling gates import
Headless JSON contracts for ready and explain
Empty fleet ≠ ready; unfinished is runtime flag not setup config

recommendations.action: Fix soft_offer_for_check: reason codes or ordered depends_on checks before generic 'no gate definition'; unit-test depends_on undefined → soft_offer_story=dep
Trim Ready interpret/interactive ceremony; always present script soft_offer including all-blocked
Clarify read-only vs mkdir; condition unfinished invite on sprint-status; optional soft-gate after board

journeys.name: Headless ready
journeys.steps: explicit ready → status.py ready → JSON with ready/blocked/soft_offer

journeys.name: Headless explain
journeys.steps: story id → status.py explain → reasons + soft_offer (bug on depends_on undefined)

journeys.name: Interactive all-blocked
journeys.steps: board shows blocked; soft_offer under-surfaced today

experience.headless: Ready when paths explicit; soft_offer bug can mis-route automators on depends_on-undefined.

findings.title: soft_offer classifies English reason substrings
findings.evidence: Substring rules infer handoff from gates.py phrasing. Order makes depends_on '{dep}' has no gate definition match 'no gate definition' first and set soft_offer_story to the checked story; the depends_on-define branch is unreachable for that shape.
findings.recommendation: Emit stable reason codes from team-gates (or shared mapping) and map codes→soft_offer; unit-test depends_on undefined.

findings.title: Builder memlog at skill root
findings.evidence: Path-standards flags .memlog.md at skill root. Same as team-ready/team-gates builder process memory pattern.
findings.recommendation: Keep builder memlog out of shipped tree (gitignore) or accept sibling convention; runtime memlog stays at planning_artifacts/team/.

findings.title: Ready bullets re-teach script filters
findings.evidence: Bullets redefine ready/blocked/unfinished semantics status.py already applied after 'trust script JSON'.
findings.recommendation: Keep empty_fleet why, do-not-flatten blocked, sprint_warning; drop semantic redefinitions.

findings.title: Interactive Ready is presentation script
findings.evidence: Prescribes cohort order and soft-offer already in script JSON.
findings.recommendation: One goal: present script cohorts/soft_offers without inventing greens; offer explain on blocked.
findings.proposed_smallest: Interactive: present the script's ready/blocked/(optional unfinished) and its soft_offers without inventing greens; offer explain for blocked. Run {workflow.on_complete} if non-empty.
findings.predicted_delta: Loss of forced ordering and one-line-reason formatting only. Route to variant eval to confirm.

findings.title: Read-only bar vs mkdir on activation
findings.evidence: Overview says read-only; activation mkdir team/ if needed.
findings.recommendation: Narrow bar to no gate/sprint mutations, or drop mkdir and treat missing team as empty fleet.

findings.title: Add: surface script soft_offer on all-blocked Ready
findings.evidence: Interactive Ready under-uses script soft_offer when ready=[] and blocked nonempty.
findings.recommendation: Always surface soft_offer fields from script JSON when present.

findings.title: Opportunity: condition unfinished invite on sprint-status
findings.evidence: Open-floor may ask unfinished before sprint resolves; empty unfinished underwhelms.
findings.recommendation: Invite unfinished only after sprint-status exists.

findings.title: Explain restates script soft_offer table
findings.evidence: Enumerates soft_offer targets already in script JSON.
findings.recommendation: Keep list reasons + apply script soft_offer; drop enumeration.

findings.title: Opportunity: add soft-gate after Ready board
findings.evidence: No soft pivot to unfinished/explain after explicit team-status.
findings.recommendation: One soft-gate after board, then stop.
